title: NASADEM Elevation & Slope — Assam Revenue Circles
description: Mean elevation and slope per Revenue Circle in Assam, derived from NASADEM (SRTM-derived) global elevation data, used as a hazard-conditioning covariate in the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk model.
purpose: Terrain covariate for the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk score model.
details: RDLS's hazard object models hazard footprints/intensity directly; elevation and slope are static terrain covariates rather than hazard intensity measurements, so 'intensity_measure' is used loosely here to fit these covariates into the schema. Elevation/slope are static (not time-varying), so no meaningful 'temporal' coverage is set. Note: the risk model's data dictionary lists a third NASADEM-attributed indicator, drainage-density (used_for_model=y) — however this repo's own top-level Sources/README.md groups drainage density with WRIS instead (see Sources/WRIS/metadata/rdls-distance-and-drainage.json, which follows the repo's own grouping and flags this same conflict).
